describes: docs(arch): record the parser decision, ownership, reuse and lineage (#812), 2026-10-09
rules: Every cell has exactly one producer node and one receiving acceptance item; per dialect it is admitted or carries a truthful exclusion reason.

Hosts: verter-lsp (the Verter LSP serves .liquid carrier documents itself), session (versioned facts the LSP operations read), mcp (DX1 public operations through the generated router), cli (verter lint and verter format), vscode-client (client registration). There is no tsgo route, no TS projection and no packages/typescript-plugin host (framework-template-carrier Delivery), so tsgoOperations is empty for every cell and no cell has a tsgo limitation.
Capability keys are LSP method names or Verter operation ids. Reconciling them to the COX0D capability vocabulary is UAP0's (docs/arch/kernel/README.md, Reconciliation owners).
A cell is support only after LIQ9-AC1 joins it to a passing fixture; this lock is static proof and claims no support (WDX0 evidence-class claim laws).
Colouring by the LIQ1G TextMate grammar is never a cell and never product evidence (LIQ1G-AC6).

facets.reason: Liquid has no descriptor surface (framework-template-carrier No facets, no tag). Snippets are carrier render contracts from LiquidDoc @param (cell LQM21), never ComponentInfo.
